scope: Additive preservation index; no historical acceptance is replaced
classification: Current generated outputs observed after reported successful post-merge original 42-command verification; not sealed approval evidence
historicalExitCodeEvidence: Product Owner reports post-merge exit 0; shell history confirms direct invocation. No complete console log retained. Partial transcript has not been supplied.
validation: Every listed regular file copied and SHA-256 compared; retained copy re-read. Tracked generated files restored to baseline Git version after preservation.
recovery: Read the private manifest, select originalPaths for this feature, validate bytes and SHA-256 before copying retained files into a separate scratch directory. Never overwrite sealed history. Machine-local location; relocation requires revalidation.
approvalLimits: Engineering evidence only; no clinical, legal, human UI, production or feature-stage approval.
